steps.title: Conga west of Omega
steps.rule: Line up north to south on the west side, 13m out: H1, caster, D1, MT, OT, D2, ranged, H2. Your place in the line decides your spot once the monitors are known.

RegenHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 4, the north-west wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 3, the south-west wall.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 13m west of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Go to 15m south-west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 15m north-west of the centre.

steps.title: Head for your layout spot
steps.rule: Monitor players go to the side Omega's cannon covers (east for the right-hand cast, west for the left): first in line to the north corner, second to the south corner, third south on the far side. Everyone else spreads on the other side in line order: north, north corner, two along the wall, south.

steps.title: Settle on your spot
steps.cue: Oversampled Wave Cannon is about to go off
steps.rule: Finish the last steps onto your spot. Monitors face so their beam points away from the party.

MainTank.rule: Run back next to Omega, just north-west of the middle, to pick it up.
